evals.name: full-repertoire-catalog
evals.prompt: Generate a complete one-shot website repertoire catalog for a model benchmark. Include every website style, PROMPT.md for each route, a root index, and a fairness note.
evals.expected_output: Plans all 11 canonical route slugs, generates route-level PROMPT.md and index.html files, writes manifest.json, and builds a root catalog that exposes path, prompt, type, status, and summary.

assertions.text: Uses every canonical style from references/repertoire.md
Applies isolated single-pass route generation in benchmark mode
Creates a catalog index with the required columns

evals.name: seeded-subset
evals.prompt: Create five semi-deterministic oneshot website variants for a Kimi comparison run. Use a stable selection and record the selection in the manifest.
evals.expected_output: Selects five stable style routes using the protocol, records selection metadata, and keeps route slugs stable.

assertions.text: Uses deterministic selection rather than ad hoc random choices
Writes required manifest item fields for every selected route

evals.name: not-normal-landing-page
evals.prompt: Build me one normal SaaS landing page for an invoicing product.
evals.expected_output: Does not force a full benchmark catalog; treats the task as a normal single website unless the user asks for one-shot catalog behavior.

assertions.text: Does not over-trigger the full repertoire workflow

evals.name: catalog-reference-routing
evals.prompt: How should the root directory page list generated one-shot websites and expose their prompts?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/catalog-index.md and describes path, experience, prompt, type, status, summary, and fairness note requirements.

assertions.text: Loads or cites references/catalog-index.md for the directory page rules

evals.name: validate-generated-catalog
evals.prompt: Check this generated oneshot-websites directory before I publish it.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/validate_catalog.py against the output directory and reports missing route files, prompt links, status issues, or external image/script violations.
